ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP screening against the VFSC prohibited and politically influential persons list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN List, and the Vanuatu Domestic Sanctions List; enhanced due diligence is required for politically influential persons under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act; all UBOs and charter counterparties must be screened before incorporation and at each vessel charter renewal.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online name reservation system (accessible via VFSC-registered agent portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be registered in English or French; any non-Latin script name must be transliterated into Latin characters; the name shall contain one of the prescribed suffixes, including 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Société Anonyme', or its abbreviation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A written appeal must be filed with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of the name rejection, accompanied by a legal memorandum substantiating linguistic distinctiveness, evidence of market use, and proposed corporate identifiers; the Registrar will determine the appeal within 15 business days; if rejected, judicial review may be sought in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is accepted only for the limited purpose of receiving correspondence; a physical registered office in Vanuatu is mandatory under the International Companies Act and must be staffed by the registered agent. For the commercial activity of offshore supply vessel leasing, mere virtual presence is unlikely to satisfy economic substance expectations of flag and charter counterparties, and a physical operating office, even if small, is strongly recommended.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 30% likelihood of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first three years of operation, rising to 45% if the entity claims tax exemption benefits, engages in high-risk charter arrangements, or has sanctioned counterparties in the vessel deployment chain.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP 222] — ss. 7-12 (Incorporation and registration), s. 18 (Registered office), ss. 20-30 (Directors and Secretary), s. 35 (Shares and no-par-value capital); complemented by the International Companies (Fees) Regulations 1994 and VFSC Regulatory Guidance
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry — Port Vila, Vanuatu (e-filing via VFSC e-Services Portal)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1) together with the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association; issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation by the VFSC Registrar
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; incorporation may proceed with one no-par-value share; no escrow capital deposit is required for an International Company; capital amount is set by board resolution only
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, as the First Board Resolution of the International Company ('the Company'), that: (1) each subscriber to the Memorandum of Association be and is hereby allotted one fully-paid share of no par value; (2) the registered office of the Company be fixed at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu; (3) the individuals executing the consent forms be and are hereby appointed as Director and Secretary respectively; (4) the Director be authorized to open banking facilities, negotiate and execute offshore supply vessel charter agreements, and instruct the registered agent regarding vessel registration; (5) the corporate seal of the Company be adopted; and (6) these resolutions take effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — Name Search Window, Port Vila, Vanuatu (online via VFSC e-Services)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-search application with the proposed company name. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'Société Anonyme' and must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered name. Pay the prescribed name reservation fee if a priority hold is required.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Certificate (if priority hold requested)
Identification of applicant and proposed director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or undesirability, file a written appeal to the VFSC Registry within 14 days or submit an alternate name from the approved reserve list.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (pursuant to s. 18 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222])
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act [CAP 222]. The governing documents must state the company name, registered office address in Vanuatu, subscriber particulars, permitted objects (including offshore marine chartering), and authority to issue no-par-value shares. Each subscriber must sign the Memorandum in the presence of a witness.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC Registrar issues a requisition on the governing documents, amend the questioned clauses by supplemental resolution and resubmit; the Company has 21 days to cure the objection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — Incorporation Desk, Port Vila, Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation pack at the VFSC Registry together with the prescribed fee. The Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1) must be executed by the registered agent and each subscriber. Standard processing takes 2-5 working days; a 24-hour expedited service is available upon payment of the expedited fee.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the application under s. 14 of the IC Act, furnish the requested particulars within 21 days; upon lapse, the application is refused but may be refiled without prejudice on payment of a new filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Finance and Accounts Office, Port Vila, Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the statutory registration fee of USD 300 (or Vanuatu Vatu equivalent) by bank draft, SWIFT wire transfer, or debit/credit card at the VFSC cashier. Obtain the official fee receipt and attach it to the incorporation application. The annual license fee is invoiced separately after incorporation.
required_dossiers: SWIFT wire reference or card payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is rejected or misapplied, re-remit via SWIFT with the correct beneficiary narrative and present the updated receipt on resubmission to avoid late-payment penalties under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — Registration and Certificates Desk, Port Vila, Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review of the incorporation pack and fee clearance, the VFSC Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation evidencing the Company's separate legal personality under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]. The certificate is counter-signed by the Registrar and delivered to the registered agent, who forwards the certified corporate kit to the Company.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If issuance is delayed beyond SLA, submit a written follow-up letter to the Certificates Desk; request VFSC priority/expedited certification for urgent charter contract execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Bank Account Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors / VFSC Licensed Registered Agent / Banking Institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting and adopt the First Board Resolution covering share allotment, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Open a corporate bank account in Vanuatu or an approved offshore banking center, and instruct the registered agent to submit the vessel registration application to Vanuatu Maritime Services Limited (VMSL) for each offshore supply vessel to be chartered.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution and meeting minutes
VFSC-certified copy of Memorandum and Articles
Corporate bank account opening application and KYC package
Vessel registration instructions to Vanuatu Maritime Services Limited
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries beneficial ownership, supply VFSC-certified corporate documents and director identification; if VMSL raises tonnage or survey requisitions, submit corrected tonnage certificates and survey reports within 10 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Maritime Services Limited (VMSL) — Vanuatu International Ship Registry, in coordination with the Vanuatu Department of Ports and Maritime, Ministry of Infrastructure and Public Utilities
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificate of Registry — Vanuatu International Ship Registry (Offshore Supply Vessel / Platform Support Class) and Operating Permit for Offshore Support Vessel Chartering and Leasing

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Meteorology & Geo-Hazards, Environment and Energy — Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Low-Risk) — EIA Registration Certificate under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act 2002; full EIA Study Report not mandated for vessel chartering/leasing activities without land-based fixed installations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: All chartered or leased offshore supply vessels must comply with MARPOL 73/78 Annexes I-V (zero oily-water discharge within 50 nautical miles of the Vanuatu coastline), hold a valid IMO International Sewage Pollution Prevention Certificate (ISPPC) and Ballast Water Management Certificate (IMO BWM Convention 2004), and maintain an Oil Record Book and Garbage Management Plan onboard.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Services for onshore offices; SOLAS Safety Equipment Certificate, Safety Construction Certificate, and International Load Line Certificate for each leased vessel; International Safety Management (ISM) Code certification; Safe Manning Document; and workplace occupational clearance issued by the Vanuatu Department of Labour under the Employment Act 2010.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue, Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; customs and VAT e-filing through ASYCUDA World and VRC's electronic services portal; corporate onboarding through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company (IC) engaged in offshore supply vessel leasing: (1) engage a licensed VFSC registered agent to incorporate the IC and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Non-Residence, and tax exemption endorsement; (2) no VRC TIN is required for purely offshore activities, but if bank or charterer requires a TIN, file the VRC TIN/VAT registration form in the name of the IC, attaching the VFSC certificate, constitutional documents, registered office address, beneficial-ownership declaration, and registered agent letter; (3) state on the form that the IC is a non-resident, tax-exempt entity with no Vanuatu-source taxable activity; VRC assigns a TIN within 10 business days after validated lodgment; (4) separately apply through ASYCUDA World for a Customs Exporter Code to lodge export declarations; and (5) maintain annual VFSC licensing fees to preserve the exempt status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election is available or necessary under Vanuatu law. The IC's classification is fixed by statute as a non-resident tax-exempt corporation outside the Vanuatu VAT and income tax net. An IC may elect the precise scope of its offshore charter activities in its constitutional documents and may obtain a formal Tax Exemption Certificate from VRC; conversion to a domestic company would automatically subject it to Vanuatu domestic tax and VAT rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998, as amended, administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs; offshore export supplies are zero-rated or outside the scope of VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory VAT registration threshold: VUV 10,000,000 annual taxable turnover in Vanuatu; voluntary registration is available below the threshold. An IC with no Vanuatu-source taxable supplies cannot be compulsorily registered; a non-resident VAT/TIN registration may be made only for administrative or counter-party facilitation purposes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu currently imposes no real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API submission mandate for VAT invoices. VAT invoices must be sequential and contain supplier TIN, invoice date, description, consideration, and VAT entry. Customs declarations must be lodged electronically through ASYCUDA World; no additional machine-readable fiscal signature is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are zero-rated when actually exported from Vanuatu and the supplier retains proof of export. Services are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Vanuatu at the time of performance and the benefit is enjoyed entirely outside Vanuatu. For ISIC 5222 offshore supply vessel leasing, zero-rating applies where the charter-party is with a non-resident, the vessel is stationed or navigates outside Vanuatu territorial waters, and any call at a Vanuatu port is limited to bunkering, stores, or force majeure without loading or discharging cargo for Vanuatu. Intrastate or inter-island use in Vanuatu would be taxable at 12.5%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged in ASYCUDA World
Original Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill, or vessel charter-party
Master's final voyage report and GPS track evidencing offshore operation
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT credit advice evidencing payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC may audit zero-rated export claims within the applicable statutory assessment period. Incomplete documentation reverses zero-rating, making output VAT payable at 12.5%, with interest and statutory penalties; input VAT credits previously refunded on the export are clawed back immediately. Fraudulent export declarations, false charter-parties, or false evidence of non-residence attract criminal fines and possible imprisonment under the VAT and Customs Acts, potential three-times-value customs penalties, cancellation of the IC tax-exemption certificate, and deregistration by VFSC.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), supported by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for International Company licensing and the Vanuatu Maritime Services Limited (VMSL) for vessel registration and maritime supervision
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains full current-account convertibility and an open capital account for International Companies. There are no statutory prohibitions on inward equity contributions, offshore borrowings, or outward profit, dividend, or charter-hire remittances, and the Vatu (VUV) is freely usable within the domestic banking system. Practical hurdles arise not from exchange-control legislation but from the shallowness of VUV/USD dealing: USD clearing for VUV is intermediated through regional correspondent banks, non-USD settlement windows are thin, and profit remittances require the IC to demonstrate genuine economic substance so that the RBV-licensed bank does not reclassify the transaction as suspicious. Dividend remittances are tax-free under the International Companies Act, but the paying bank will require a current Certificate of Good Standing, a life-certificate of the directors and ultimate beneficial owners, and an APG/CFATF-style compliance declaration to evidence that the entity is not a de-risked shell.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio for foreign-currency export or vessel-leasing receipts, and no prescribed timeline for repatriation. A Vanuatu International Company may retain charter-hire income indefinitely in USD or any permitted foreign currency in its offshore or domestic accounts, subject only to the RBV's standard reporting thresholds for suspicious transaction monitoring and the bank's internal commercial credit policies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. Vanuatu has no domestic Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing category; an offshore digital EMI must separately hold an International Banking Licence from the VFSC under the International Banking Act. Such an entity is prohibited from taking VUV deposits or providing settlement accounts to a Vanuatu IC without an RBV banking licence and is practically de-risked by global correspondent banks because of the offshore-marine chartering and offshore supply vessel (OSV) exposure of this account profile. The use of an unlicensed offshore EMI for treasury flows should be treated as an automatic compliance red flag and is inadvisable for capital escrow or operational disbursement functions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance at the branch is generally mandatory for at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner during the initial onboarding interview for a newly incorporated non-resident International Company. Remote opening is not permitted unless a VFSC-licensed agent has physically conducted the KYC interview, the client is introduced under an existing banking relationship, and the RBV-licensed bank's board approves a written exception. All original certified copies of passport, proof of address, and corporate registers must be apostilled and delivered through the licensed agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company structure with historical bearer share capability, nominee directors, and opaque ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing, current register of directors and members, statutory declaration of beneficial ownership, notarised and apostilled passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners, a legal opinion confirming that no bearer shares are outstanding and that the company is not a shell, and an organisational chart showing the complete ownership chain to natural persons or regulated holding entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for vessel acquisition attributed to opaque or unstructured chartering receipts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or internally reviewed financial statements of the charterer, the executed time charter or bareboat charter party with commercial invoices, vessel registry abstracts from the Vanuatu Maritime Services Limited (VMSL), P&I Club certificate of entry, third-party ship valuation or class survey certificates, and at least six months of bank statements evidencing consistent charter-hire cash flows from identifiable counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and maritime sector exposure arising from offshore platform support operations in sensitive waters
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening clearance from UN, OFAC, and EU consolidated lists, a deployment schedule and AIS geofencing report confirming exclusion from sanctioned waters, charter-party or master service agreement compliance clauses, end-user and beneficial-cargo attestations, coastal state operating permits, and a maritime security compliance report from an internationally recognised provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Introduction through an unregulated third-party introducer or offshore formation agent lacking substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A notarised and apostilled KYC package prepared by the introducer, certified passport copies and recent utility bills of all directors and shareholders, a banker's reference letter from the introducing bank transmitted by SWIFT or embossed on the bank's letterhead, and a KYC confirmation certificate from the Vanuatu-licensed agent who physically verified the identity of the principals.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity injections must route via SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's bank into the Vanuatu International Company's designated capital escrow account at a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank. The intended payment purpose code should be the equity / capital contribution code recognised by the receiving bank (commonly '310' or the bank-specific 'EQUITY' business code), while charter-related funds should be coded as 'SI' (ship and air transport services) or 'FS' (operational leasing) where permitted; a generic 'INTR' or missing code will be rejected or suspended by compliance. Each wiring instruction must be accompanied by a board resolution approving the capital call, a subscribed share schedule, the subscription agreement, and source-of-wealth documentation for the transferring entity. The bank will also require a current VFSC agent confirmation, the VMSL shipping licence or certificate for the vessel subject to the OSV leasing scope, and matching legal beneficiary name on the account. Funds must be fully cleared and verified against the sanctioned-party list before any deployment, and any third-party same-day onward transfer will trigger enhanced due diligence.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for offshore supply vessel acquisition, charterer deposits, and operational costs will move over three clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for operational charter-hire payments, crew wages, P&I insurance premiums, and bunker settlement, with MT202 COV for interbank reimbursement legs; (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit issued under UCP600 via SWIFT MT700 and amended via MT720 for vessel purchase, dry-dock instalments, and equipment import, with presentation of bills of lading, commercial invoices, class certificates, and survey reports at the counters of the confirming bank; and (iii) maritime escrow release instructions executed conditionally upon vessel redelivery certificates, bunker survey reconciliation, or class-survey approval. Every outbound instruction must be signed by two authorised signatories, supported by the underlying charter party or sale and purchase agreement, and checked against the VFSC prohibition on bearer dividends and blanket third-party disbursement authorities.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts with cash settlement in USD, permitted only against documented charter-receivable or vessel-acquisition exposure
Deliverable spot and outright forward contracts in USD/VUV, USD/AUD, EUR/USD and AUD/NZD executed through RBV-licensed domestic commercial banks for confirmed operational cash flows

Cross-currency swaps and vanilla interest rate swaps with VFSC-regulated international dealers, conditional on an underlying vessel financing agreement and on the keeping of an adequate economic-substance file
Natural hedging through a multi-currency ledger structure using USD for charter revenue and debt service, AUD for bunker and Australian crew costs, and VUV for payroll and domestic agency fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the unpaid fee per month or part thereof; continued non-payment for 6 months results in administrative strike-off and dissolution of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Vanuatu (records available for VFSC inspection)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At the time of the annual fee payment, on or before 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm agent instructions may delay the annual fee payment and trigger late penalties or automatic deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Record Review (UBO Annual Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (maintained as a private statutory record; no public registry filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June, or within 30 days of any ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain accurate UBO records may lead to fines of up to VUV 10,000,000 under Vanuatu AML/CFT laws and suspension of the agent or vessel charter license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a Vanuatu International Company unless the company applies for a special license (e.g., maritime charter or financial services) and the VFSC imposes an audit condition, or if the company voluntarily opts for audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or Vanuatu Equivalent Standards if prepared; International Companies are otherwise exempt from filing accounts with the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must annually obtain a director's declaration confirming the current UBO list, verify any shareholding transfers recorded in the Register of Members, and retain the confirmation on file for at least 5 years. No annual UBO return is filed with the VFSC.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (with share transfers and dates)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, or estate duty. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is categorised as a non-resident tax-exempt entity when it does not derive income from domestic Vanuatu sources. The effective tax rate is therefore zero without requiring a tax holiday or preferential deduction election. Registered capital is exempt from stamp duty up to VT 1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu imposes no income tax return. The mandatory compliance filing is the VFSC Annual Return (International Company Form) submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Services online portal, accompanied by the annual license fee renewal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return must be lodged within six (6) months after the anniversary of the company's date of incorporation. The annual license fee is payable on or before the same anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1: Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Official IC name and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name as per the certificate of incorporation. No local tax identification number is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2: Registered Office Address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the IC's registered office maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the street address of the registered agent; a PO Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Automatically populated from agent's e-Services account; verify accuracy before submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationality, and residential addresses of all directors and shareholder(s).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders may be listed; no Vanuatu income tax declaration or residency status is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorised and issued shares, par value, and classes of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Statement that no shares are offered to the Vanuatu domestic public, preserving the IC's offshore exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC is not carrying on business with Vanuatu residents and owns no real property in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory statutory declaration. A false declaration triggers deregistration and director liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment of the VFSC annual fee; typically VT 300 per class A share class arrangement, subject to current VFSC fee schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay via wire transfer or e-Services card payment before the anniversary deadline.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement of the Annual Return attracts a VFSC late fee of VT 10,000–20,000. Continued default results in automatic strike-off of the IC from the register, asset vesting risk, and a restoration fee of VT 50,000 or more payable to VFSC. There are no income tax surcharges because no income tax law exists.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu imposes no domestic withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties, or charter hire paid by an IC to non-residents. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) in force; therefore no treaty relief procedure or TRC is required for outbound payments from Vanuatu. Where a foreign tax authority insists on evidence of Vanuatu tax status, the VFSC or the Vanuatu Inland Revenue may issue a Certificate of Tax Residency / Non-Residence confirming the IC's nil tax liability, subject to a documentary application and agent certification. Effective treaty relief is achieved by not being a Vanuatu tax resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory domestic rate: 0% for interest, royalties, and IP licence fees. Treaty rate: not applicable (no DTA network). Foreign payors should conduct their own withholding analysis under the payor's domestic tax law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in Vatu. Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and therefore no statutory Local File or Master File transfer pricing documentation thresholds. The arm's-length principle is nevertheless relevant for foreign counterparties seeking deductibility of charter hire or fees paid to the Vanuatu IC in their own jurisdictions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019 and the Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations require every IC conducting a 'relevant activity' to maintain economic substance in Vanuatu. Vessel chartering and offshore marine transport services (ISIC 5222) fall within the 'shipping' and 'transport' relevant activity categories. The IC must annually demonstrate: (a) management and control exercised in Vanuatu; (b) adequate physical premises and employees in Vanuatu proportionate to the vessel chartering activity; (c) operating expenditure incurred in Vanuatu; and (d) core income-generating activities performed in Vanuatu, including crew employment, vessel maintenance decision-making, and charter negotiation. Annual ESR notification and the retention of contemporaneous substance files are mandatory.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Making false statements to foreign tax authorities claiming the Vanuatu IC is a 'resident' for treaty or exemption purposes while providing no substance, or fabricating expense deductions or charter revenues.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under Vanuatu's Penal Code [Cap. 135] for fraud and perjury; fines up to VT 100 million or asset confiscation under the Proceeds of Crime Act; international exchange of information under the Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEA) network may expose the underlying beneficial owner to foreign criminal tax proceedings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal criminal liability, civil restitution orders, travel bans, and imprisonment of up to 7 years for knowingly authorising false declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Vanuatu IC as a pure booking centre with no physical office, no employees, no locally kept books and records, and no substance documentation while holding itself out as an offshore supply vessel lessor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance Regulations penalties: initial fine of VT 1,000,000, escalating to VT 5,000,000 for continued non-compliance; automatic information exchange to the foreign parent jurisdiction; revocation of the IC's certificate of incorporation; strike-off from the VFSC register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Statutory directors are personally disqualified from acting as directors for up to 5 years, subjected to restoration surcharges, and held jointly and severally liable for the company's ESR penalties and unpaid charges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting charter payments in cash or cryptocurrency without customer due diligence, failing to appoint a nominated compliance officer, or failing to file suspicious transaction reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) for maritime escrow payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement action under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 288]: fines of VT 5,000,000 per violation; forfeiture of the escrowed funds; freezing orders on all Vanuatu bank accounts; revocation of the IC's registered agent services leading to deregistration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fines, travel bans, confiscation of personal assets, and imprisonment for up to 10 years for wilful AML non-compliance or money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Chartering the offshore supply vessel to a Vanuatu domestic customer, employing Vanuatu residents in crew roles, or holding a lease over real property in Vanuatu — all prohibited for a non-resident IC without converting to a local company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Vanuatu International Companies Act renders the offending contract void; the IC is subject to deregistration, a penalty of VT 10,000 per prohibited transaction, and potential civil suits by counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorised the prohibited domestic business are personally liable to indemnify the injured counterparty, face exclusion from reincorporation for 3 years, and may be compelled to pay the company's penalties out of personal funds.
